title: What I'm Learning About Building Trustworthy AI
excerpt: Exploring why responsible AI requires more than a good model and how developers can think about reliability, transparency, and user trust.
content: Building AI systems is not only about getting a model to produce accurate results. It is also about understanding how people interact with the system and where things can go wrong.
As I continue learning about AI and machine learning, I am exploring ideas around transparency, reliability, responsible development, and meaningful human oversight.
These principles are becoming increasingly important as AI moves from experiments and prototypes into applications that people rely on.

title: Exploring the Backend Stack for AI Applications
excerpt: What I'm learning about connecting AI models with APIs, databases, and modern backend technologies.
content: An AI application needs more than a machine learning model. It also needs a backend capable of connecting the model to users, data, and other parts of the application.
Through my projects, I have been exploring technologies such as Django, FastAPI, databases, APIs, and different approaches to integrating AI into web applications.
The more I build, the more I understand how important good architecture, clear data flow, authentication, and reliable APIs are to making an application work beyond the model itself.

title: Learning in Public: Building Through Curiosity
excerpt: A reflection on learning software development, AI, and NLP by building projects and learning from the process.
content: Learning technology is rarely a straight line. Some concepts make sense immediately, while others require building, breaking things, and trying again.
As a student and junior developer, I have found that building projects is one of the most effective ways for me to turn concepts into practical understanding.
My current journey spans software development, artificial intelligence, machine learning, NLP, and security, and I am continuing to learn by experimenting and creating.
